attr.title: Wetrix
attr.desc: ARM64 native recompilation of Wetrix (N64) with a GLES renderer. Bring your own ROM. Credits: N64Recomp / N64ModernRuntime (Wiseguy and contributors); Fast3D (Emill, MaikelChan) via the Perfect Dark port; Wetrix recompilation and port by Wetrix Enjoyers.
attr.inst: Put your own US Wetrix ROM (.z64, .n64 or .v64, any name) in the wetrix/ folder, then launch. No ROM data is included.
